description: User-defined table functions: CREATE / OR REPLACE / parameters / joins / multiple columns / DROP, called via TABLE(f()). Converted 1:1 from functions/UserDefinedTableFunctionTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql:
CREATE FUNCTION t()
    RETURNS TABLE(msg VARCHAR)
    AS
    $$
        SELECT 'Hello'
        UNION
        SELECT 'World'
    $$

CREATE FUNCTION greet()
    RETURNS TABLE(msg VARCHAR)
    AS $$
        SELECT 'Hello' UNION SELECT 'World'
    $$
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS TABLE(v VARCHAR) AS $$ SELECT 'v1' $$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION t() RETURNS TABLE(v VARCHAR) AS $$ SELECT 'v2' $$

CREATE FUNCTION repeat_msg(n INTEGER)
    RETURNS TABLE(msg VARCHAR)
    AS $$
        SELECT 'hello'
    $$
CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)

CREATE FUNCTION two_rows()
    RETURNS TABLE(val VARCHAR)
    AS $$ SELECT 'x' UNION SELECT 'y' $$

SELECT i.name
FROM items i, TABLE(two_rows()) f

CREATE FUNCTION multi()
    RETURNS TABLE(id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
    AS $$
        SELECT 1, 'Alice'
        UNION
        SELECT 2, 'Bob'
    $$
CREATE FUNCTION to_drop() RETURNS TABLE(v VARCHAR) AS $$ SELECT 'x' $$
